4101.o: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Arathandris Silversky in Felwood.

4102.o: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Maybess Riverbreeze in Felwood.

4120.o: Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas wants you to kill 12 Angerclaw Grizzlies and 12 Felpaw Ravagers in Felwood.

4121.o: Escort your prisoner, Grark Lorkrub, through Burning Steppes and through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge.$B$BYou recall Lexlort mentioning that he would have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.$B$BYou will also be required to hand over your Thorium Shackles to Lexlort.

4122.o: Travel to the Burning Steppes and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress.$B$BWhen you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. Lexlort will have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.$B

4123.o: Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.

4124.o: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

4125.o: Locate the courier’s boat somewhere along the coast of Feralas.

4126.o: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos.

4127.o: Return to Feathermoon Stronghold and show Ginro Hearthkindle the Discarded Knife you have found.

4129.o: Take the Discarded Knife to Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

4130.o: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

4131.o: Search the Woodpaw Gnoll camps of southern Feralas for evidence of the courier’s belongings or the courier himself.

4132.o: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay General Angerforge! Return to Warlord Goretooth when the task is complete.

4133.o: Speak with Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

4134.o: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

4135.o: Now that Raschal’s last known whereabouts have been discovered, continue your search for him or his remains in the Writhing Deep.  According to the note, it is located to the south of the Woodpaw gnoll camps.

4136.o: Bring Ribbly’s Head to Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

4141.o: Collect 15 Bloodpetals and return to Muigin.

4142.o: Take a Bloodpetal to Gregan Brewspewer in Feralas.

4143.o: Collect 5 samples of Atal’ai Haze, then return to Muigin in Un’Goro Crater.

4145.o: Hunt 5 Bloodpetal Lashers, 5 Bloodpetal Threshers, 5 Bloodpetal Flayers and 5 Bloodpetal Trappers for Larion at Marshal’s Refuge.

4146.o: Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal’ai Haze to Larion in Marshal’s Refuge.

4147.o: Travel to Marvon Rivetseeker’s workshop in Ratchet.

4161.o: Collect 7 Small Spider Legs for Zarrin in Dolanaar.

4181.o: If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

4182.o: Slay 15 Black Broodlings, 10 Black Dragonspawn, 4 Black Wyrmkin and 1 Black Drake. Return to Helendis Riverhorn when the task is complete.

4183.o: Travel to Lakeshire and deliver Helendis Riverhorn’s Letter to Magistrate Solomon.

4184.o: Travel to Stormwind and deliver Solomon’s Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.$B$BBolvar resides in Stormwind Keep.

4185.o: Speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon after speaking with Lady Katrana Prestor.

4186.o: Take Bolvar’s Decree to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.$B

4201.o: Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara’s Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.

4223.o: Speak with Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes.

4224.o: Speak with Ragged John to learn of Marshal Windsor’s fate and return to Marshal Maxwell when you have completed this task.$B$BYou recall Marshal Maxwell telling you to search for him in a cave to the north.

4241.o: Travel to Blackrock Mountain in the northwest and enter Blackrock Depths. Find out what became of Marshal Windsor.$B$BYou recall Ragged John talking about Windsor being dragged off to a prison.

4242.o: Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.

4244.o: Find a Mithril Casing and return to A-Me 01 in Un’Goro Crater.

4245.o: Escort A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel in Un’Goro Crater.

4261.o: Escort Arei to safety, then speak with Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song, in eastern Ashenvale.

4262.o: Slay Overmaster Pyron and return to Jalinda Sprig.$B$BYou recall Jalinda talking about Pyron guarding the quarry. Perhaps you should search there?

4263.o: Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!

4264.o: You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.

4265.o: Free Raschal from the Zukk’ash hive.$B$BReturn to Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold and let him know that Raschal is alive and well.

4266.o: Speak with Shandris Feathermoon in Feathermoon Stronghold.

4267.o: Bring Raschal’s Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.

4281.o: Bring the Undelivered Parcel to Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar.

4282.o: Return Marshal Windsor’s Lost Information.$B$BMarshal Windsor believes that the information is being held by Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge.

4283.o: Oralius wants 50 Blackrock Medallions. Chances are high that these medallions can be found on the orcs in the Burning Steppes.

4284.o: Collect 7 Power Crystals of each color: red, blue, yellow, and green. Bring them to J.D. Collie at Marshal’s Refuge.

4285.o: Discover the location of the Northern Crystal Pylon in Un’Goro Crater.

4286.o: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs. Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these ’fanny pack’ contraptions.$B

4287.o: Discover the location of the Eastern Crystal Pylon in Un’Goro Crater.

4288.o: Discover the location of the Western Crystal Pylon.

4289.o: Bring 2 Un’Goro Gorilla Pelts, 2 Un’Goro Stomper Pelts, and 2 Un’Goro Thunderer Pelts to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un’Goro Crater.

4290.o: Find the carcass of Lar’korwi’s freshest kill and steal a Piece of Threshadon Carcass before returning to Torwa Pathfinder in Un’Goro Crater.

4291.o: Bring 2 Ravasaur Pheromone Glands to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un’Goro Crater.

4292.o: Using the contents of Torwa’s Pouch, summon Lar’korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar’korwi’s Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un’Goro Crater.

4293.o: Gather Felwood Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Felwood. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most corrupt. Bring 5 of the Corrupted Felwood Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

4294.o: Gather Un’Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Un’Goro Crater. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un’Goro Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

4296.o: Bring the Tablet Transcript to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.

4297.o: Bring 5 Silvermane Stalker Flanks to Agnar Beastamer in Hinterlands.

4298.o: Speak to Agnar Beastamer in the Hinterlands.

4300.o: Bring 8 White Ravasaur Claws to Jes’rimon in Orgrimmar.

4301.o: Bring U’cha’s Pelt to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un’Goro Crater.

4321.o: Speak with J.D. Collie in a moment.

4322.o: Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.

4324.o: Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

4341.o: Travel to Blackrock Depths and find Kharan Mighthammer.$B$BThe King mentioned that Kharan was being held prisoner there - perhaps you should try looking for a prison.

4342.o: Listen as Kharan Mighthammer tells his story.
